name: Underworld Empire VR
summary:
Welcome to the criminal underworld.

**Underworld Empire VR** is a unique blend of tactile VR crafting, tactical shooting, and high-stakes territory management. You aren't just a boss sitting in a static safehouse; your entire base of operations is a mobile chemistry van that you drive directly into the neon-lit, toon-shaded underbelly of the city.

🚐 BECOME THE UNDERWORLD KINGPIN
